sentences.text: Drainlogic Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-29 under the industry code 37000, sewerage.

No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is sewerage, which is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
